1| ;;;; markdown.lisp — assistant text to styled lines. A compact port of the
     2| ;;;; shapes crates/tui/src/markdown.rs renders: headings, fenced code, quotes,
     3| ;;;; lists, GFM pipe tables, and the inline spans a code assistant actually
     4| ;;;; meets (bold, italic, inline code). Not a full CommonMark implementation —
     5| ;;;; the Rust file is equally explicit about what it skips.
     6| ;;;;
     7| ;;;; A LINE is a list of segments; a segment is (string . style-spec) where the
     8| ;;;; spec is a plist for style-index. The renderer interns them.
     9| 
    10| (in-package #:leticl)
    11| 
    12| (defun appendf-attr (style key value)
    13|   (append style (list key value)))
    14| 
    15| (defun %inline-spans (text style)
    16|   "Inline markdown to segments: `code`, **bold**, *italic*."
    17|   (let ((segs nil)
    18|         (buf (make-string-output-stream))
    19|         (n (length text))
    20|         (i 0))
    21|     (flet ((flush ()
    22|              (let ((s (get-output-stream-string buf)))
    23|                (when (plusp (length s))
    24|                  (push (cons s style) segs)))))
    25|       (loop while (< i n)
    26|             do (cond
    27|                  ((char= (char text i) #\`)
    28|                   (let ((end (position #\` text :start (1+ i))))
    29|                     (if end
    30|                         (progn (flush)
    31|                                (push (cons (subseq text (1+ i) end) '(:fg :cyan)) segs)
    32|                                (setf i (1+ end)))
    33|                         (progn (write-char #\` buf) (incf i)))))
    34|                  ((and (< i (1- n)) (char= (char text i) #\*) (char= (char text (1+ i)) #\*))
    35|                   (let ((end (search "**" text :start2 (+ i 2))))
    36|                     (if end
    37|                         (progn (flush)
    38|                                (push (cons (subseq text (+ i 2) end)
    39|                                            (appendf-attr style :bold t))
    40|                                      segs)
    41|                                (setf i (+ end 2)))
    42|                         (progn (write-char #\* buf) (incf i)))))
    43|                  ((char= (char text i) #\*)
    44|                   (let ((end (position #\* text :start (1+ i))))
    45|                     (if (and end (> end (1+ i)))
    46|                         (progn (flush)
    47|                                (push (cons (subseq text (1+ i) end)
    48|                                            (appendf-attr style :italic t))
    49|                                      segs)
    50|                                (setf i (1+ end)))
    51|                         (progn (write-char #\* buf) (incf i)))))
    52|                  (t (write-char (char text i) buf) (incf i))))
    53|       (flush))
    54|     (nreverse segs)))
    55| 
    56| (defun markdown-lines (text &optional (base-style nil))
    57|   "TEXT to a list of lines, each a list of (string . style-spec) segments."
    58|   (let ((lines nil)
    59|         (in-code nil)
    60|         (code-lang "")
    61|         (table-rows nil))
    62|     (labels ((flush-table ()
    63|                (when table-rows
    64|                  (dolist (l (render-table (nreverse table-rows)))
    65|                    (push l lines))
    66|                  (setf table-rows nil))))
    67|       (dolist (line (uiop:split-string text :separator '(#\newline)))
    68|         (cond
    69|           ;; fenced code
    70|           ((and (>= (length line) 3) (string= (subseq line 0 3) "```"))
    71|            (flush-table)
    72|            (if in-code
    73|                (setf in-code nil)
    74|                (progn (setf in-code t
    75|                             code-lang (string-trim " `" (subseq line 3)))
    76|                       (push (list (cons (if (plusp (length code-lang))
    77|                                             (format nil "── ~a " code-lang)
    78|                                             "── ")
    79|                                         '(:fg :bright-black)))
    80|                             lines))))
    81|           (in-code
    82|            (flush-table)
    83|            (push (list (cons line '(:fg :bright-black))) lines))
    84|           ;; heading
    85|           ((and (plusp (length line)) (char= (char line 0) #\#))
    86|            (flush-table)
    87|            (let* ((level (position-if (lambda (c) (char/= c #\#)) line))
    88|                   (body (string-trim " #" line)))
    89|              (push (list (cons body
    90|                                (case (min (or level 1) 3)
    91|                                  (1 '(:bold t :underline t))
    92|                                  (2 '(:bold t))
    93|                                  (t '(:bold t :fg :bright-white)))))
    94|                    lines)))
    95|           ;; blockquote
    96|           ((and (plusp (length line)) (char= (char line 0) #\>))
    97|            (flush-table)
    98|            (push (list (cons "│ " '(:fg :bright-black))
    99|                        (cons (string-trim " " (subseq line 1))
   100|                              '(:italic t :fg :bright-black)))
   101|                  lines))
   102|           ;; table rows collect until the table ends
   103|           ((%table-row-p line) (push line table-rows))
   104|           ;; list item
   105|           ((and (> (length line) 1)
   106|                 (member (char line 0) '(#\- #\*))
   107|                 (char= (char line 1) #\space))
   108|            (flush-table)
   109|            (push (list (cons "• " '(:fg :bright-cyan))
   110|                        (cons (subseq line 2) base-style))
   111|                  lines))
   112|           ((and (> (length line) 2)
   113|                 (digit-char-p (char line 0))
   114|                 (string= (subseq line 1 (min 2 (length line))) ". "))
   115|            (flush-table)
   116|            (push (list (cons (subseq line 0 2) '(:fg :bright-cyan))
   117|                        (cons (subseq line 2) base-style))
   118|                  lines))
   119|           ;; blank
   120|           ((zerop (length (string-trim " " line)))
   121|            (flush-table)
   122|            (push nil lines))
   123|           ;; plain paragraph
   124|           (t
   125|            (flush-table)
   126|            (push (%inline-spans line base-style) lines))))
   127|     (flush-table)
   128|     (nreverse lines))))
   129| 
   130| (defun %table-row-p (line)
   131|   "A GFM pipe row: has a pipe and is not a delimiter row (markdown.rs:476)."
   132|   (and (plusp (length line))
   133|        (find #\| line)
   134|        (not (every (lambda (c) (member c '(#\space #\- #\: #\|))) line))))
   135| 
   136| (defun render-table (rows)
   137|   "Rows to aligned lines: header bold, columns padded to the widest cell.
   138| The column count is the header's; a row with more cells keeps them
   139| (render.rs:360 keeps them too)."
   140|   (when rows
   141|     (let* ((cells (mapcar #'split-cells rows))
   142|            (header (first cells))
   143|            (ncols (length header))
   144|            (widths (make-array ncols :initial-element 0)))
   145|       (loop for row in cells
   146|             do (loop for i from 0
   147|                      for c in row
   148|                      while (< i ncols)
   149|                      do (setf (aref widths i)
   150|                               (max (aref widths i) (string-width c)))))
   151|       (flet ((emit (row style)
   152|                (let ((segs nil))
   153|                  (loop for i from 0
   154|                        for c in row
   155|                        while (< i ncols)
   156|                        do (push (cons (pad-to c (aref widths i)) style) segs)
   157|                           (unless (= i (1- ncols))
   158|                             (push (cons " │ " '(:fg :bright-black)) segs)))
   159|                  (list (nreverse segs)))))
   160|         (append
   161|          (emit header '(:bold t))
   162|          (emit (make-list ncols :initial-element "") '(:fg :bright-black))
   163|          (loop for row in (rest cells)
   164|                append (emit row nil)))))))
   165| 
   166| (defun split-cells (line)
   167|   "The cells of one table row, outer pipes dropped, \\| kept literal
   168| (markdown.rs:481)."
   169|   (let ((cells nil)
   170|         (cur (make-string-output-stream))
   171|         (n (length line)))
   172|     (let ((i 0))
   173|       (loop while (< i n)
   174|             do (cond
   175|                  ((and (char= (char line i) #\\) (< i (1- n)) (char= (char line (1+ i)) #\|))
   176|                   (write-char #\| cur) (incf i 2))
   177|                  ((char= (char line i) #\|)
   178|                   (push (get-output-stream-string cur) cells) (incf i))
   179|                  (t (write-char (char line i) cur) (incf i)))))
   180|     (push (get-output-stream-string cur) cells)
   181|     (setf cells (nreverse cells))
   182|     (when (and cells (zerop (length (string-trim " " (first cells)))))
   183|       (setf cells (rest cells)))
   184|     (when (and (> (length cells) 1)
   185|                (zerop (length (string-trim " " (first (last cells))))))
   186|       (setf cells (butlast cells)))
   187|     (mapcar (lambda (c) (string-trim " " c)) cells)))
   188| 
   189| (defun pad-to (string width)
   190|   (let ((w (string-width string)))
   191|     (if (< w width)
   192|         (concatenate 'string string (make-string (- width w) :initial-element #\space))
   193|         string)))
